title: Stramit Corporation Pty Ltd - acquisition of AG&S Building Systems Pty Ltd

timeline.event: Stramit Corporation Pty Ltd acquired AG&S Building Systems Pty Ltd.
ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC decided not to oppose the acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Stramit Corporation Pty Ltd has acquired AG&S Building Systems, trading as Fair Dinkum Homes and Sheds. Stramit is a manufacturer and supplier of steel roll formed products and AG&S provides services to the shed building and assembly industry.
body_sections.Market definition: The acquisition was considered in the context of separate markets for the supply of steel roll formed products and the supply of steel frame sheds and buildings.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 22 August 2007 the ACCC formed the view that the acquisition is not likely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets due to a number of actual and potential competitors who would be likely to constrain Stramit from attempting to exercise market power.
